summary: Download Facebook Reels, videos and stories in HD - fast and private
description:
DownVid - FB Reels Downloader
Save public Facebook Reels, videos, stories, and live replays directly to your device in just one tap.

Key features
• Download any public Facebook Reel or video
• Save in HD and 4K when available
• Choose between different quality options (HD, Full HD, SD)
• 100% private – no Facebook login needed
• Your activity stays completely hidden
• Copy link or share from Facebook → paste → download
• Automatic link detection when you paste
• Built-in video player for smooth playback
• All downloads saved to Downloads → DownVid folder
• View and manage your videos anytime, even offline
• Dark mode support
• No account or sign-in required
• Works on Wi-Fi and mobile data
How to download in 3 simple steps

Open Facebook, copy the Reel or video link
Open DownVid – the link is detected automatically
Pick your quality and tap Download

Perfect for saving
• Funny and viral Reels
• Workout routines and tutorials
• Cooking recipes and dance videos
• Motivational clips and life hacks
• Any public video you want to keep offline

Privacy & Security
• Never asks for your Facebook login
• No tracking or personal data collection
• Downloads come directly from Facebook servers
• We respect creator rights and copyright

Important note
DownVid only works with public Reels, videos, and stories. Private content cannot be downloaded (this follows Facebook’s privacy rules).

Supported content
• Facebook Reels
• Public videos and posts
• Public stories
• Live video replays (when available)

Download DownVid today and start saving your favorite Facebook moments offline!
